# DEAD FREQUENCY — Dialogue & Audio Script

*Generated from `game/data/*.gd` by `tools/gen_docs.py`. This is the exact text the game displays (subtitles) and the casting/recording script for voice-over. Do not edit by hand — edit the data and regenerate.*

Speaker tags: `NAME (1998)` = 89.1 echo of the past · `NAME (96.1 MHz)` etc. = live transmission · `NAME?` = the Listener imitating that person · `(TAPE)` = recording · `PA` = facility public address.

**Voice-over status:** no voice actors are recorded yet. In the current build every line is subtitled and accompanied by a procedural radio-voice texture (see 11_ASSET_PRODUCTION_LIST.md).

## PROLOGUE — OCTOBER 17, 1998

### Opening

**EVELYN (RECORDING)** — Project log. Doctor Evelyn Voss, director, HELIX-9. Nineteenth consecutive night on the carrier.
**EVELYN (RECORDING)** — We built this place to listen. I think I finally understand what that costs.
**OKAFOR** — Carrier's holding at one-oh-seven point nine. Doctor… it's answering.
**EVELYN** — It can't answer. We haven't sent anything.
**OKAFOR** — Then who is it talking to?
**EVELYN** — Twenty twenty-six. That's not a fault, Tunde. That's a date.
**PA** — Attention. Containment fault, sublevel four. All personnel remain at your stations.
**MARCUS (RADIO)** — Hale to all posts. Seal the lower levels. Nobody opens the Door. Nobody.
**EVELYN** — Mayday, mayday. This is HELIX-9 to any station. Can anyone hear me?
**EVELYN** — We opened it. We opened it, and something heard us.
**MIRA** — Doctor Voss — the lift's still running. Come with us. Please.
**EVELYN** — Take him, Mira. Take him up to the surface and do not look back.
**MIRA** — I'm not leaving you down here—
**EVELYN** — Go!
**DANIEL? (STATIC)** — …whatever happens… do not open the door.
**EVELYN** — Who is this? Identify yourself. Who is on this channel?
**VOICE** — Can anyone hear me?

## CHAPTER 01 — THE ARRIVAL

### Opening

**DISPATCH (KESSLER)** — Northline to Arlen. You at the gate yet?
**DANIEL** — At the gate. Snow gave up about a mile back. Now it's just rain.
**DISPATCH (KESSLER)** — Beacon's still pinging. Same message every ninety seconds, three weeks running.
**DANIEL** — Read it to me.
**DISPATCH (KESSLER)** — 'Request communications technician. Arlen, Daniel.' Over and over. Your name, Danny. From a box nobody's touched since nineteen ninety-eight.
**DANIEL** — Somebody typed my name into a database once, and the database got lonely. That's all it is.
**DISPATCH (KESSLER)** — That's what I keep telling myself. Four hours, Danny. Check in on the hour.
**DANIEL** — On the hour.
**DANIEL** — ...The blast door's open. Nobody said the blast door would be open.
**DANIEL** — Twenty-eight years of dust, and the emergency lamps still think someone's coming home.
**DANIEL** — Right. Power, uplink, records, out. Four hours, and I'm back above the snow line.

### Pickup — HX-7 field receiver

**DANIEL** — HX-7 field receiver. Same model I trained on.
**DANIEL** — …Cell's still holding a charge. After twenty-eight years. That isn't possible.

### Radio 89.1 MHz — “Gate post, 1998”

**GUARD (1998)** — Post Two to Hale. Chief, the lower doors just cycled. By themselves.
**MARCUS (1998)** — Say again, Two.
**GUARD (1998)** — They opened, sir. All of them. There's nobody down there to open them.
**MARCUS (1998)** — Then close them. And Two — if you hear me tell you to open anything tonight, it isn't me.
**DANIEL** — That's… that's not a recording. That's live carrier. From nineteen ninety-eight.

### Pickup — Ceramic fuse

**DANIEL** — Ceramic fuse. Thirty amp. The auxiliary generator will take that.

### Interaction — “Fit fuse and start generator”

**DANIEL** — There. Auxiliary bus is live.
**PA** — Welcome back. Auxiliary power restored. Current time — zero two — forty-three. Staff on site — forty-two.
**DANIEL** — Forty-two. …The work order said forty-one.

### Trigger `1`

**DANIEL** — …Someone was standing there. At the end of the hall. Someone tall.
**DANIEL** — Trick of the light. Old ballasts. Keep moving, Arlen.

### Trigger `w`

**DANIEL? (101.3 MHz)** — Daniel…
**DANIEL** — Who is this? This channel is — who's transmitting?
**DANIEL? (101.3 MHz)** — Daniel. Whatever happens. Do not open the door.
**DANIEL** — That's my voice.
**DANIEL** — That is my voice.

**MARCUS (TAPE)** — Security log, Hale. Twelfth of October.
**MARCUS (TAPE)** — Voss calls it 'the correspondent'. Like it's a pen pal. The signals team call it the Listener, and I think they've got the better of it.
**MARCUS (TAPE)** — It doesn't talk. It repeats. It takes whatever you give it and hands it back in your own mouth.

**MARCUS (TAPE)** — 'Arlen.' Nobody here called Arlen.

### Document — “Memo — M. Hale, Chief of Security”

> TO: All posts
> FROM: Hale
> 
> Three rules. They are not suggestions.
> 
> 1. Nothing below sublevel two is opened without the Director AND me, in person, in the same room.
> 2. If you hear a colleague on the radio and cannot see that colleague, you do not act on what you hear. You come and find me.
> 3. Nobody uses a receiver alone. Ever. It knows when you are alone.
> 
> I don't care how it sounds. I care that you go home.
> — M.H.

**DISPATCH? (98.5 MHz)** — Four hours, Danny. Four hours, Danny. Four hours, Danny.
**DANIEL** — That's what he said at the gate. Word for word. Same breath. Same crackle on the 'D'.
**DANIEL** — It's not him. It's him played back. It doesn't make words. It takes them.

## CHAPTER 11 — EVERY VOICE EVER LOST

### Opening

**PA** — Current time: zero two — forty-three.
**DANIEL** — The Archive. Every page this place ever printed, every tape it ever cut.
**DANIEL** — Hale kept a vault down here. So did she. If there's a truth in this mountain, it's on a shelf.

### Document — “Archive index card”

> HELIX-9 ARCHIVE — INDEX
> 
> Stacks A–E ........ project records 1991–1998
> Box 19 ............ RUN 19 (empty — removed by order)
> Vault S ........... security. Hale only.
> Vault D ........... Director. Voss only.
> 
> The deep lift to the Aperture level runs from the east end of the stacks.
> Archive keycard required. The duty archivist keeps it in the stacks, 'somewhere sensible', which in practice means anywhere.

### Document — “Sealed statement — Cpl. I. Duarte”

> STATEMENT OF CPL. INES DUARTE, POST ONE
> SEALED BY ORDER OF THE DIRECTORATE — 18 OCT 1998
> 
> At approximately 02:46 Technician M. Solace came up in the service lift carrying the Director's son. She was crying. She put him in my arms and pinned a card to his blanket. The card said: HIS NAME IS DANIEL. DON'T LET THEM BRING HIM BACK HERE.
> 
> She said: 'Drive. Don't stop. Don't turn the radio on.'
> 
> She went back down. I watched the lights in the shaft go out floor by floor, like something was eating them.
> 
> I drove. I did not turn the radio on. At the bottom of the mountain it turned itself on, and it was her voice, saying thank you.
> 
> I did not stop.
> 
> The boy was placed with the county. I asked that his name be changed. I asked that nobody ever tell him where he came from.
> 
> I am told the family is called Arlen.

### Document — “Taped to the Director's vault”

> VAULT D — DIRECTOR
> 
> Combination per Dr. Voss: 'It opens at the moment it all ends.'
> 
> (Below, in Hale's hand:)
> That's not a combination, Evelyn. That's a threat.
> 
> (Below that, in hers:)
> It's both, Marcus. Most things are.

### Tape — “Marcus Hale — last report”

**HALE (TAPE)** — Hale. Two-fifty, seventeenth of October. This is my last report, so I'll make it a good one.
**HALE (TAPE)** — At two forty-nine I sealed the containment bulkhead with twenty-three people behind it. Mira Solace looked at me through the glass while I did it. I want that on the record. I want somebody to know I saw her face.
**HALE (TAPE)** — It didn't matter. It isn't behind the bulkhead. It's in the line. It's in every set in this mountain. I sealed twenty-three people in for nothing.
**HALE (TAPE)** — So here's my last order. It's for whoever finds this, whenever that is.
**HALE (TAPE)** — If you hear me on the radio after tonight — it isn't me. I'm dead. I'm dead at two fifty-one, and I've made my peace with it.
**HALE (TAPE)** — Whatever I tell you on that channel, do the opposite. If I tell you to open a door, you leave it shut. If I tell you to switch something on, you cut the cable.
**HALE (TAPE)** — Kate, if this ever finds you: I kept my word as long as I could.
**HALE (TAPE)** — ...It's here. It's using my voice in the corridor. Sounds just like me. Funny. I never liked my voice.
**HALE? (103.7 MHz)** — Arlen. Don't waste time down there. The chamber. Get to the chamber.
**DANIEL** — Hale's dead. He died at two fifty-one, in nineteen ninety-eight. I just heard him say so.
**LISTENER (DANIEL'S VOICE, 103.7 MHz)** — Then who have you been talking to, Daniel?
**DANIEL** — You. It was always you. The uplink. The chamber. Everything 'Hale' wanted, you wanted.
**DANIEL** — Do the opposite. Whatever it tells me — do the opposite.

### Tape — “Dr. Voss — for Daniel”

**EVELYN (TAPE)** — Danny.
**EVELYN (TAPE)** — If you're hearing this, you found the vault. Which means you're grown, and you came back. Which means I failed at the one thing I asked of anyone. I asked them never to let you come back.
**EVELYN (TAPE)** — So I'll assume you're as stubborn as I am, and I'll say what I need to say.
**EVELYN (TAPE)** — I'm sorry. I brought you down here because you slept. That's the truth. It's a small, selfish truth, and it's the worst thing I ever did.
**EVELYN (TAPE)** — It wants you because you were the first one who ever heard it without being afraid. You laughed at it. Nobody had ever laughed at it.
**EVELYN (TAPE)** — There's a key with this tape. It collapses the Aperture. Everything in the line goes silent — it, and everything that's left of us. If you turn it, we're gone. All of us. Mira too. That's all right. That's allowed.
**EVELYN (TAPE)** — But if you're braver than I was — if you've gathered our real voices, if you know who to trust — there is a third way. Don't open the door. Don't just close it. Answer it. Send us back down the line, all of us together. And don't do it alone.
**EVELYN (TAPE)** — It can't wear a choir. It can only wear the lonely.
**EVELYN (TAPE)** — Little light. Signal and answer. I love you. I've always loved you. Go home.
